title: 港股恒生指数10月5日收盘：+0.28%至24,040点，科技股领涨0.62%
summary: 国庆黄金周期间港股于10月5日（周一）收升0.28%，报24,040.34点，科技股涨0.62%领涨，半导体及PCB板块亮眼；全日成交约988亿港元。A股仍处假期，10月8日（周四）复牌。
why: 港股是组合多只成份股的核心交易市场，恒指当日涨跌与成交量是评估持仓风险及市场情绪的首要参考。

title: 黄金周半程：21.3亿人次出行，人均消费低于预期，景区收入+30%，消费K型分化加剧
summary: 2026年国庆黄金周前半程（10月1日至4日）：全国出行人次约21.3亿，同比增约8%；但人均消费低于预期，呈现景区旅游收入+30%强劲、非必选消费疲软的K型分化格局。A股10月8日（周四）复牌，市场将重新定价消费板块预期。
why: 消费板块（携程TCOM、海底捞6862、蜜雪冰城2097等持仓）直接受国内消费数据驱动，黄金周数据是A/港股10月开局最重要的宏观指标之一。

title: US Week Ahead: FOMC Minutes Wednesday, ISM Services PMI Today, 10Y Yield Holds Near 24-Year High of 5.28%
summary: Three macro events dominate US trading this week: (1) September ISM Services PMI releases Monday Oct 5 (consensus 55.0 vs August 55.4); (2) FOMC September meeting minutes release Wednesday Oct 8, offering clarity on Fed Chair Warsh's rate path; (3) 10-year Treasury yield holding near 5.28%, its highest since 2002, sustaining pressure on growth and tech equities.
why: FOMC minutes and Treasury yield trajectory are the two most critical variables for the portfolio's covered-call and sell-put strategy across US holdings (NVDA, PLTR, GOOGL, MU, TSLA, WMT, COST).

title: Nvidia DGX Spark 64GB Launches at $4,999; Ships Oct 23 via Acer/Dell/HP — AI Desktop PC Goes Mainstream
summary: Nvidia announced a 64GB variant of the DGX Spark personal AI supercomputer at $4,999 (the 128GB model rises to $6,950). Powered by the GB10 Grace Blackwell Superchip, it supports AI models up to 100B parameters and ships October 23 through Acer, ASUS, Dell, Gigabyte, HP, and MSI. A new Nvidia Sync Cluster feature lets two 64GB units pool to 128GB at 1.7x performance.
why: Signals the AI hardware democratization phase: a sub-$5,000 personal supercomputer represents a new TAM layer for Nvidia (NVDA, portfolio holding) and validates the sustained AI capex cycle underpinning the AI infrastructure investment thesis.

title: US Court Dismisses Chegg and Penske AI Search Antitrust Suits vs Google; Sets Landmark AI Legal Precedent
summary: US District Judge Amit Mehta dismissed antitrust lawsuits by Chegg and Penske Media against Google's AI Overviews on Oct 1, ruling plaintiffs failed to establish federal antitrust violations. Mehta wrote: 'An expectation is not an agreement,' and stated antitrust law cannot substitute for lawmakers in addressing AI's economic fallout on publishers. Chegg shares fell ~9%.
why: Landmark ruling removes a key legal overhang for Alphabet/Google (GOOGL, portfolio holding). Favorable precedent for AI search monetization across the sector; reduces the risk of class-action copycat suits limiting Google's AI Overviews rollout.
